scope: G3 functional branch only: native-platform boundary CI restoration, NF08 leaf-probe statistics seeks, dev/test digest optimization and the C-reconstructed index Start reservation; no produced image, GWIN0 package, installed index run or native C activation

branch_policy.owner_decision: On 29 October 2026 the owner kept further sequence-19 G2 testing and GWIN0 completion on feature/g3-gwin0-beta and moved G3 functional development to this branch

implementation: CI environment only (c658442, 4dadefd, 1425122, 42a3408): runner snapshots carry luma-content, luma-content-store, the two include_bytes fixture files and the src/, scripts/ and web/ sources native discovery reads; every Rust or harness container has a private mode-0700 ext4 storage root and a 640 MiB memlock bound; platform unit tests run serially; storage and TPM boundaries are separate jobs; the TPM job compiles all workspace test artifacts once before its timed tests; the diagnostics directory is handed to the runner user before upload
Dev/test build profile only (37ba720): the sha2 digest crate is optimized; every rehash and check and the release profile are unchanged

Statistics lower-bound seeks binary-search inside each fully validated leaf instead of descending from the root once per posting rank (ad4d8ce); every page is still read through the original live boundary, validated and rehashed, and no parsed or authorization cache is introduced

Fixture-only corrections (ad4d8ce): the admin peer fixture retries its own binding while libtest retires an earlier test thread; the staging harness gives its disposable container the laboratory release identity; the TPM harness removes the PAM profile it created
The closed worker publisher and historical replay compile into the test build under explicit dead-code allowances (dcc3264); nothing is dispatched

Slice 1: transition review DATA has one constructor shared by planning and C reconstruction; the C Start verifier reconstructs the first job from the selected owner and the current fixed builder, accepts only an exact Start request for an owner without a C-selected index leaf and re-proves the builder under the original boundary

Slice 1: the closed canonical Start reservation record (at most 64 KiB) binds base, request input, transition review, compiled metadata liability, capacity and original attribution; a failed or expired attempt retains the full liability; replay rebuilds it from fresh DATA under the current check and requires equality

Slice 1: the worker reserve path shares the phase-preparation finish step and refuses a token of the other kind; its event class compiles only in test builds and the direct reader refuses it before selecting that class

environment.storage: Disposable private ext4 work directories on drive D
